title: Astral Calamity Extras
description: Some extra materials to the modpack Astral Calamity.
body:
This mod adds 24 new materials/mostly ingots that are dropped by bosses in my modpack Astral Calamity, and are adjusted to some new crafting recipes to balance out the gameplay. Items that have an * before their names are items that are already added to the corresponding bosses from other mods. Items that have a + before their names are items that will be added in the following updates of this mod. The items include:

Wrought Ingot - Ferrous Wroughtnaut

*Colossal Iron Ingot - The Iron Colossus

Cryonic Ingot - The Frostmaw

Subliminal Ingot - The Yeti

Gilded Ingot - The Goblin Lord

------------------------------------------

OTHER


Hexite Ingot - The Boss Rush

 

This mod does NOT add armor nor weapons/tools YET, only materials, so feel free to alter recipes using kubejs or other mods to your liking!
